misconceptions.description: Believing a clean, well-typeset screen is therefore accessible
misconceptions.trigger: review judges the screen by appearance instead of named WCAG criteria
misconceptions.feedback: Check against specific success criteria (alt text, contrast, color cues); looking clean is not an accessibility finding.

misconceptions.description: Conveying a required action using color alone
misconceptions.trigger: the only cue for the next action is a color, with no label or icon
misconceptions.feedback: Add a text label or icon so the action is conveyed in more than one channel (WCAG 1.4.1).

misconceptions.description: Assuming a content-bearing diagram needs no alt text
misconceptions.trigger: an informative image has empty or missing alt text
misconceptions.feedback: Give content images a one-sentence alt description naming what they show and why it matters (WCAG 1.1.1).
